messages:
tara: Heads-up: new onboarding sample deployment to Cloudflare Pages failed after we removed file extensions from our exports mapping.

jon: What error do users see?

tara: At deploy: `Uncaught TypeError: (0 , _redwoodSdk.default) is not a function` and in editor: `Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood-sdk'`.

sam: Can you paste the package.json exports we shipped?

tara: snippet:
```json"exports": {
  ".": "./dist/index",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

jon: Oh — pointing at `./dist/index` (no extension) means Node and bundlers resolve differently. Cloudflare Pages/Esm loaders prefer `.mjs` and our rollup output is `index.mjs` so it falls back oddly and causes default-wrapper interop.

sam: Also TS server can't map `index.d.ts` because we didn't add a top-level `types` field and subpath mapping to `./dist/index.d.ts` is missing.

qa-bot: created ticket RED-5632: "exports extensionless entry causes ESM runtime default interop + typing misses" assigned to sam.

jon: Short fix: update exports to be explicit: "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" for the top-level `.` export and add "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" at top level.

tara: For immediate unblock I patched the sample to use `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const RetryPolicy = Redwood.RetryPolicy || Redwood.default?.RetryPolicy;` ugly but gets onboarding working.

sam: Long term: build change — ensure rollup emits named exports in ESM instead of default wrapper; add a test in CI that installs the package in a pure-ESM sandbox (Pages or Bun) and runs `node --input-type=module` smoke import. Also add `tsc --noEmit` check against samples.

devdocs: I'll add a docs note about runtime caveats and update the sample templates to always use ESM imports and explicit named imports once the SDK is fixed.

jon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1321 with exports fix + types field + CI smoke.

tara: Thanks — will escalate to onboarding and CS for the one customer who hit this during setup.

sam: Will land PR after CI green and follow up with a small release note.

devdocs: Added a todo to the onboarding checklist to run samples in an ESM runtime before publishing templates.
